title: Delivery and service fees, effective 3 August 2026
text: This fee schedule applies to restaurant and quick grocery delivery orders in every Brambleway Eats city from 3 August 2026 and replaces the fee schedule dated 1 March 2025. The delivery fee depends on the distance between the restaurant or grocery hub and the delivery address: £0.99 for up to 1 mile, £1.99 for 1 to 2.5 miles, £2.99 for 2.5 to 4 miles, and £3.79 for 4 to 6 miles. Orders to addresses more than 6 miles away are not accepted. A busy-period surcharge of £1.00 may be added on Friday and Saturday evenings between 6 pm and 9 pm and whenever a severe weather alert is active; it is always shown before checkout. The service fee is charged on top of the delivery fee and is 9 percent of the basket subtotal, with a minimum of £0.59 and capped at £3.49 per order. Brambleway Plus members pay a reduced service fee of 5 percent on restaurant orders over £15; the service fee is otherwise not waived by membership. Click-and-collect orders have no delivery fee and a flat service fee of £0.49. All fees are refunded in full if an order is cancelled by the restaurant or by Brambleway Eats. If an order arrives more than 30 minutes after the latest time in the delivery estimate, the delivery fee is refunded automatically as Brambleway credit within 24 hours.

title: Delivery and service fees, effective 1 March 2025 (superseded)
text: Status: superseded on 3 August 2026 by the current delivery and service fee schedule. This page is kept for reference because orders placed before 3 August 2026 were charged on it. Under this schedule the delivery fee was £1.49 for up to 1.5 miles, £2.49 for 1.5 to 3 miles, and £3.49 for 3 to 5 miles, and orders to addresses more than 5 miles away were not accepted. There was no busy-period surcharge. The service fee was 7 percent of the basket subtotal, with a minimum of £0.49 and a cap of £2.99 per order, and it applied in the same way to members and non-members. Click-and-collect orders had no delivery fee and no service fee. Late delivery refunds were not automatic: a customer whose order arrived more than 45 minutes after the latest estimated time could ask for the delivery fee back through chat within 24 hours, and it was refunded as credit. Customers who believe an order placed before the changeover was charged under the wrong schedule can ask for a review through Order help within 30 days of the order date.

title: Minimum basket rules and small order fee
text: Restaurant orders have no platform minimum, but when the food subtotal is under £12 a small order fee is added to make up the difference to £12, up to a maximum small order fee of £3.00. A restaurant can set its own higher minimum, which is shown at the top of its menu page, and in that case the order cannot be placed below it. Quick grocery orders, which are packed at our neighbourhood hubs and delivered in about 20 to 30 minutes, need a minimum basket of £15, and there is no small order fee option: the checkout will not go through below £15. Scheduled grocery orders, booked in one-hour slots up to 7 days ahead, need a minimum basket of £40, and a basket charge of £1.50 applies to scheduled orders under £60. Alcohol, tobacco alternatives, gift cards and bottle deposit charges do not count towards either grocery minimum. If items are later removed because they are out of stock or rejected substitutes take the basket below the minimum, no extra charge is added after the order has been placed. Click-and-collect orders have a minimum of £5 for both restaurants and hubs, and no small order fee.

title: Brambleway Plus membership: price, benefits and cancellation
text: Brambleway Plus costs £7.99 a month or £69 a year, billed in advance on the day you join and on the same date each period. Members get free delivery on restaurant orders over £15 and on quick grocery orders over £25, a reduced restaurant service fee of 5 percent on orders over £15, and priority chat support. The busy-period surcharge still applies to members. Free delivery does not apply to restaurants marked as own delivery or to scheduled grocery slots on Saturdays. You can cancel at any time under Account, then Plus. Cancellation takes effect immediately: member benefits stop at the moment you cancel, not at the end of the period you have already paid for, so orders placed after cancelling are charged standard fees. Monthly members get no refund for the unused part of the month. Annual members who cancel within 14 days of a renewal payment, and have not used any member benefit since that renewal, get a full refund to their card; after that, annual members get a pro-rata refund as Brambleway credit, minus a £10 admin charge. Monthly members can pause instead of cancelling, for 1 or 2 months, once in any 12-month period; no fee is taken and no benefits apply while paused.

title: Changing or cancelling an order after it is placed
text: Restaurant orders can be cancelled free of charge until the restaurant accepts the order, which usually happens within 2 to 4 minutes. Once the restaurant has accepted, cancelling is charged at 50 percent of the food subtotal, and once the rider has collected the order it cannot be cancelled and is charged in full. Items cannot be added to a restaurant order after it is placed; place a separate order instead. The delivery address can be changed in the app only before the rider collects the order, and only to an address within 1 mile of the original; if the new address falls in a higher distance band, the difference in delivery fee is charged. Any other address change has to be cancelled and re-ordered under the rules above. Quick grocery orders can be cancelled free until picking starts, usually within 2 minutes, and cost £2.50 to cancel after that; they cannot be edited once placed. Scheduled grocery orders can be edited, with items added or removed, until 11 pm the night before for slots starting before noon, or until 3 hours before the slot start for later slots, and can be cancelled free up to the same cut-off.

title: Missing, damaged or incorrect items: reporting and refunds
text: Report missing, damaged, spilled or incorrect items in the app under Order help. Restaurant order problems must be reported within 24 hours of delivery; quick grocery and scheduled grocery problems must be reported within 72 hours. For damaged or spilled items a photo of the item and its packaging is required. By default, approved refunds are paid as Brambleway credit, which appears in your account straight away and can be used on any order within 12 months. A refund goes back to the original card only if you choose Refund to card when reporting the problem, or if you ask within 7 days of the credit being issued and the credit is still unused; card refunds take 3 to 5 working days to appear. Brambleway credit cannot be withdrawn as cash. If a whole order never arrives, the full amount, including fees and tip, is refunded to the original payment method automatically. For food that arrives cold or late but is otherwise correct, the refund is limited to the delivery fee unless the food is unsafe to eat. Claims for more than £40 on a single order are checked by a specialist within 2 working days before any refund is made.

title: Alcohol and other age-restricted items
text: Brambleway Eats operates Challenge 25. Riders must check photo ID at the door for every order containing alcohol, tobacco alternatives, lighter refills or solvents, if the person receiving it looks under 25. Accepted ID is a passport, a photocard driving licence, a proof of age card with the PASS hologram, or a military ID card. The person receiving the order must be 18 or over and must not appear drunk, and the contactless drop option is not available for orders with age-restricted items. If the ID check fails or nobody can show valid ID, the result depends on the order type. For restaurant orders, the rider keeps back only the alcoholic items, which are refunded as Brambleway credit, and hands over the rest of the food. For quick grocery and scheduled grocery orders, the whole order is returned to the hub, because sealed bags cannot be split at the door, and the order is refunded minus a £5 failed ID check fee. Alcohol ordering hours: in England and Wales alcohol can be ordered between 8 am and 11 pm. In Scotland, including Glasgow and Edinburgh, alcohol orders are accepted only between 10 am and 9:30 pm, so that every alcohol delivery is completed by 10 pm.

title: Substitutions on grocery orders
text: Each item in a quick grocery or scheduled grocery order has a substitution setting: Best match, which is the default, Choose a specific swap, or No substitute. Pickers substitute with a similar item of the same or larger size. If the substitute costs more, you pay the price of the item you ordered; if it costs less, you pay the lower price. Substitutes are listed in the app before the rider leaves the hub and on the receipt. Substitutes can't be handed back to the rider at the door, because riders are not allowed to take returned goods back into the hub. Instead, reject a substitute in the app within 2 hours of delivery and you will get Brambleway credit for the full substitute price; you can keep or dispose of the item. Fresh meat, fish and baby formula are never swapped for a different brand unless you picked Choose a specific swap. Items with a free-from claim, such as gluten free or nut free, are only replaced with items carrying the same claim. If no suitable substitute is in stock, the item is removed and its price is not charged.

title: Restaurant delivery hours by city
text: Restaurant delivery runs from 11 am to 11 pm, Sunday to Thursday, in every city we serve. Late-night restaurant delivery on Friday and Saturday nights runs as follows: Manchester city centre and Leeds until 2 am; Birmingham until 1:30 am; Glasgow and Newcastle until 1 am; Bristol, Cardiff, Nottingham and Edinburgh until midnight. After 11 pm the delivery radius is reduced to 3 miles in every city. Breakfast delivery starts at 7:30 am in Manchester, Leeds and Bristol only. Individual restaurants may keep shorter hours than these, and the app only shows restaurants that are open and within range. On bank holidays restaurant delivery follows Sunday hours. There is no delivery on Christmas Day, and on Boxing Day restaurant delivery starts at 12 noon. These hours are for restaurant orders only; quick grocery hours are set separately for each city.

title: Quick grocery delivery hours by city
text: Quick grocery orders are packed at our neighbourhood hubs and delivered in about 20 to 30 minutes. In Manchester and Leeds, quick grocery delivery runs from 7 am to midnight every day. In Glasgow and Birmingham it runs from 8 am to 11 pm every day. In Bristol, Cardiff, Newcastle, Nottingham and Edinburgh it runs from 8 am to 10 pm, Sunday to Thursday, and until 11 pm on Friday and Saturday. Alcohol can only be ordered within the alcohol ordering hours, which are shorter in Scotland. Scheduled grocery slots, booked up to 7 days ahead, run in one-hour slots from 8 am to 10 pm in every city. Hubs are closed on Christmas Day and open from 10 am to 6 pm on Boxing Day and New Year's Day. When a hub is very busy the app may pause quick grocery ordering for up to 30 minutes and offer the next scheduled slot instead. These hours are for grocery orders only; restaurant delivery hours are listed separately.

title: Rider tips, contactless drop and waiting time
text: Tips are optional. You can add a tip at checkout, or afterwards from the order page for up to 48 hours after the order is delivered. A tip added at checkout can be changed or removed until 1 hour after delivery. The maximum in-app tip is £20 per order. 100 percent of every tip goes to the rider and is paid with their weekly earnings; Brambleway Eats takes no fee from tips. Tips are not refunded when part of an order is refunded, only when the whole order never arrives. Cash tips are also fine. Contactless drop: choose Leave at door at checkout, and the rider will leave the order at your door, knock or ring, take a photo and step back at least 2 metres. Contactless drop is not available for orders with age-restricted items. In blocks of flats, riders deliver to the flat door only if they are let into the building; orders are never left in shared lobbies. If you don't answer, the rider waits 8 minutes at the address and tries to call you twice. After 8 minutes the order is returned, marked as delivered, and is not refunded, unless you chose Leave at door, in which case it is left at the door.

title: Promo codes, referral credit and the Plus free trial
text: New customers get a welcome code worth £8 off their first restaurant order, with a minimum spend of £20 on food, not counting fees or tips. The code must be used within 14 days of creating the account. Only one promo code can be used per order, and codes can't be combined, but a code can be used together with Plus free delivery. Discounts apply to the food or grocery subtotal only, never to fees or tips, and codes cannot be used on alcohol in Scotland. If you cancel an order that used a code, the code is not reinstated; if the restaurant or Brambleway Eats cancels it, the code is reinstated within 24 hours. Referral credit: when a friend joins with your link and completes a first order over £15, you both get £5 credit, up to 10 referrals a year. Plus free trial: new members can try Brambleway Plus free for 30 days. The trial does not roll into a paid membership automatically; when the 30 days end the benefits stop, and you are only charged if you choose to continue by tapping Keep Plus. One free trial is allowed per person, payment card and delivery address.

title: Click-and-collect
text: Click-and-collect is available from participating restaurants and from every quick grocery hub. There is no delivery fee and a flat service fee of £0.49, and the minimum order is £5. After you order, the app shows a ready time. Restaurant click-and-collect orders are held for 15 minutes after the ready time, and grocery hub orders for 30 minutes. If an order is not picked up in that time it is cancelled and charged in full with no refund, because the food cannot be resold. You can tap I'm running late once per order to add another 10 minutes to the holding time. Someone else can collect for you if you share the 4-digit collection code shown in the app, but orders with age-restricted items can only be collected by the account holder with photo ID. Hubs have a marked collection counter at the front; for restaurants, ask staff for Brambleway collection orders. Collected orders can't be swapped for delivery after the ready time.

title: Allergen information and who is responsible
text: Restaurants and grocery suppliers are responsible for the allergen information shown on menus and product pages. Restaurants must be able to tell you which of the 14 major allergens are in a dish, and the allergen details on each menu item are supplied by the restaurant, not checked by Brambleway Eats. Our support team cannot confirm whether a dish is safe for a particular allergy. If you have an allergy, use the Contact restaurant button on the menu page or the order page, which works until the rider collects the order, and ask the restaurant directly. Allergy notes added at checkout are passed to the restaurant but are not a guarantee. Grocery product photos may not show the latest packaging, so always check the label on the item you receive before eating it. If a restaurant gave wrong allergen information, report it under Order help within 24 hours; you will get a full refund to your card and the restaurant will be reviewed. If you have a reaction, get medical help first.

title: Refund abuse, account suspension and complaints
text: Accounts are reviewed automatically when they make more than 4 refund claims in 60 days, or when refunds add up to more than 30 percent of the value of their orders over 90 days. While an account is under review, every claim needs a photo and refunds are paid as Brambleway credit only. If a review finds claims that cannot be supported, the first step is a written warning; a second finding within 12 months leads to a 30-day suspension, and a third leads to permanent closure. When an account is closed, promotional credit is forfeited but credit bought as a gift card is refunded. You can appeal a suspension within 14 days by replying to the suspension email. Complaints: raise the problem in chat first; if it is not sorted, ask for it to go to Customer Relations, or call 0161 496 0731 between 9 am and 6 pm, Monday to Friday. Customer Relations acknowledges complaints within 2 working days and sends a final response within 10 working days, or 20 working days for complex cases. If you are still unhappy after the final response, you can refer the complaint free of charge to the independent dispute resolution service named in that response within 8 weeks.
